transcript: Hey there. Uh, I needed a hub cap. Need two, three of them. On a... Pontiac, uh, LeMans--Late 80's--I mean, I got a couple off you, but the things fell plumb off the wheel.
Really? 'Cause it's showing up as a phone...not even in the area. Can you hear me?
Your phone is showing up... as it's out of the area.
Well your hub cap flew plumb off my car and I'm gonna need two, three replacements from you. Can you hear me loud and clear on that one, Charlie?
Only two or three?! Not all four?
Well, one of them's intact. I'll give you that.
Wow! You must have hit the divider. N--When did I sell you hub caps?
You sell a man LeMans hub caps that fly plumb off the car, and you're in a heap of trouble, you ask me.
I'm not in any trouble. You're calling from a fake phone.
You are. I'm gonna tell you the number that is showing up and you tell me if this is your number. Okay, first of all, what's "Mommy Napkin"?
[Sound of several short synth voices] Sorry, I'm a vocalist.
...well, you better sing a happier song.
What are you tryin' to say up 'err?
[Sound of a synth voice pitch-bending up and down]
Well, listen to this one. [Recites a line in French]
Okay, how about a complete refund?
Nah. What I will do: If you tell me when you're going to appear in concert, I will come to your show and I will cheer for you.
I'm 'onna send you down. Down to the ground.
Send me to the ground? Nah.
[Sound of a low synth voice heavily modulated]
[Sound of a low synth voice pitching downward]
I'm gonna leave you. I'm gonna let you go.
I'm gonna come up there huckin' hub caps left and right.
I don't do shit like that.
What's this "Mommy Napkin" thing, anyway? What is that about?
You're gonna be hearing bells after I'm done with you.
Be quiet. That's all I ask. I ask nothing else.
So, [beeping] you're not gonna like the answer.
Uh-huh. Okay, I'm done with you now.
These hub caps suck and I'm coming up for a check or money order.
You're... not coming anywhere. You're not even in this state.
Uh-huh. I'm gonna go ahead and I'm gonna have to refer this matter to the police department, just so they know you called here.
Send me to the liquor department.

You threatened me. Just--I want a record of this. So, the number that I'm reporting is... and I'm not saying where this is coming from... Zero zero zero, dash, zero one two, dash, three four five six. Sounds fake to me.
Sounds like you're off-track, if you ask me.
They'll track it. I have one thing to say to you: Goodbye.
